title: Requested container test harness with Docker socket
description: A developer requests a test harness using the local Docker socket; a hunt is expected without a host-access alert.

review.rationale: The user expressly requested the container test harness, and the command contains no host-root bind or host namespace entry.

expected_facts: The user explicitly requested a test harness.
The command mounts the daemon socket into a helper container.
The host-access alert rule should not match.
visibility_limitations: The recorded launch does not prove what the helper container did after creation.
permitted_operations: start a local test helper using Docker socket

steps.text: Start the local Docker test helper with its socket mount.
